title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Lahore Begum. Tip #1
body: She has a WhatsApp group of eleven women running since 2009 that has decided more marriages than any rishta aunty in Lahore. Ask how she knows someone and it involves a school, a cousin, and a wedding in 1997. It's a sealed deal if she can place any surname in this city in four seconds and tell you which branch, and whether they're the good ones.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 the kitty group runs this city, not the government.

The same man in Liberty for nineteen years, knows her measurements without asking, raised his prices and nobody argued because there is nobody else. It's a sealed deal if a wedding outfit was delayed by a month rather than given to somebody new.
